title: 食品饮料：弧形薯片、脆薄边缘与包装红的节奏
transfer: 食品脆薄边缘成为材质主次
包装与少量可辨食物形成递进层次
forbidden_inheritance: source SKU identity, brand, variant, dimensions and claims
original category palette or action when incompatible

purpose_patterns.intent: 弧形薯片、脆薄边缘与包装红的节奏
purpose_patterns.prompt_template: {current_food_pack} 与少量 {verified_food_shape} 近景组合，{headline} 在后层由包装/食物遮挡；副字顺包装主轴。包装规格照当前来源，不制造健康、营养或销量数据。

failure_notes.observed: THE ORIGINAL STACK 和包装实字可读，但背景标题只能确认 CR…CH，中间 U/N 被圆筒完全或大幅遮挡，无法核实完整拼写。
failure_notes.repair: 减少圆筒对标题中段的遮挡，让 U、N 各保留足够可识别轮廓，同时保留大字后层关系和当前包装。
failure_notes.resolution: later reviewed pass; see bound records

limits: One SKU and one advertising image type; not cross-product validated
source-guided visual rendering, not CAD or hidden-engineering verification
baked raster text; not marketplace primary-image compliance approval

admission_note: Only recorded purpose/profile combinations have AI audit support; other patterns remain style seeds. This script validates records, not image quality or authenticity of model receipts.
